title: SysBio Phenotype Comparator Browser
bodyHtml:
Explore side-by-side comparisons of differential gene expression between two human phenotype and cell type combinations. Results are based on differential gene expression analyses within human tissues derived from the Accelerating Medicines Partnership (AMP) programs. Differential expression analyses were performed on harmonized pseudobulked single-cell or single nucleus RNA-sequencing (RNA-seq) data from AMP AD, AMP CMD, AMP PDRD, and AMP RA/SLE. The current interface is a small proof of concept that will be expanded with additional datasets in the future. 

Begin by selecting two comparisons to visualize results. Within the "side by side comparison" tab, the volcano plots show all differentially expressed genes within each comparison. Hover for more information about each differentially expressed gene, and click to view details in the table below. Within the "direct comparison" tab, view scatterplots comparing the log fold-change of each comparison. View top enriched annotations for all upregulated or downregulated genes using the module at the bottom of the page. 

Learn more about the underlying datasets or data harmonization procedures. 

Abbreviations:
  • AD: Alzheimer's disease
  • Astro: astrocyte
  • CMD: common metabolic disease
  • Endo: endothelial cell
  • Micro PVM: microglia or perivascular macrophages
  • Oligo: oligodendrocyte
  • OPC: oligodendrocyte progenitor cell
  • PDRD: Parkinson's disease and related disorders
  • RASLE: rheumatoid arthritis or systemic lupus erythematous
